_sources: provisions: 1961 s.45 / 2025 s.67 (coverage MODELLED, D-248). summary: S2 s.67(1) (Gazette 265620 p.104); 1961 s.45(1) (thc p.261). the within-head set-off route moved to SEC-SET-OFF-WITHIN-HEAD, the section its rule cites (W-165, D-388). routes[0]: RATE-CG-SHORT-LISTED-EQUITY, RATE-CG-LONG-OTHER, RATE-CG-LONG-LISTED-EQUITY (W-088b, D-244). disqualifiers[0]: the gain's amount is portfolio's (DR 13 R-10); assets portfolio does not hold are the brief's built-second scope (00-BRIEF.md section 9, M-08). disqualifiers[1]: S2 s.67(1) 'save as otherwise provided in sections 82 ... 89' / 1961 s.45(1) 'save as otherwise provided in sections 54 ... 54H' — the reinvestment exemptions, W-088i (S2 s.86 / 1961 s.54F) and DEFERRED (the rest).
summary: A profit on transferring a capital asset is income under the head Capital gains, in the year the transfer takes place. Gains and losses are netted within the head, and each kind of gain is then taxed at its own rate.

routes.name: Each kind of gain taxed at its own rate
routes.description: Short-term gains on listed equity, long-term gains on listed equity and other long-term gains each carry their own rate.

disqualifiers.description: Gains on assets the portfolio does not hold, such as property or unlisted shares, are not yet computed.

enforcedBy.reason: gains on assets outside the portfolio are deferred in the coverage register

disqualifiers.description: A gain reinvested as the law allows, for example in a residential house, is not charged.

enforcedBy.reason: the reinvestment exemptions are planned or deferred in the coverage register
